_comment: Single source of truth for deep links between sugardepth.com and the scanner app. Read by both the Expo app (src/config/appLinks.ts) and the marketing site (sites/sugardepth/src/data/app-links.ts). Identifiers that only exist once Apple/Google are set up (team id, bundle id, android package, signing fingerprint) are NOT here: they come from build-time env vars, see .env.example.
